title: The same placement with the other side to move is a different position and does not count
rationale: The converse half of mx-rep-002, isolated as its own assertion: the prefix at which the piece placement has stood on the board three times, at plies 0, 5 and 10, but with Black to move at ply 5. Position identity includes the side to move, so ply 5 records a different position and the position now on the board is only at its second occurrence: the game is ongoing and no draw may be claimed. An implementation that keyed repetition on piece placement alone, or that compared only the first FEN field, would wrongly report a claimable draw here.
